  "ledger": [
    "Red apple | One whole, round red fruit held at chest height in the central woman's right hand, beside the umbrella shaft | Still whole when last clearly visible; progressively concealed by her hands as the camera moves toward her back around 00:08 | Travels and bobs with her carrying hand; no visible bite, release, transfer, duplication, or demonstrated disappearance.",
    "Blue handheld umbrella | Open blue canopy overhead, nearly vertical silver shaft supported by the central woman's left hand | Remains open overhead in the same possession | Translates and tilts slightly with her walking and hand movement; changing camera angle reveals its underside and then upper surface.",
    "Black shoulder bag on passing woman | First visible around 00:00.75, suspended by a diagonal strap beside the light-blue-shirted woman's hip | Remains with that woman as she walks away and becomes obscured | Swings and translates with its carrier; no visible transfer or state change.",
    "Blue shoulder bag on red-shirted pedestrian | Suspended at her right hip in the background | Remains at her hip until she leaves the visible area | Moves with her walking; no visible transfer or unexplained change.",
    "Blue bottle carried by patterned-shirt pedestrian | Upright blue container hanging from her right hand in the background | Still carried while visible, then leaves the frame | Swings with her arm as she walks; no visible opening, pouring, or transfer; contents cannot be assessed.",
    "Phone held by background woman near the end | Small rectangular object raised in one hand when she enters view around 00:09.50 | Remains raised in that hand at the last frame | Enters view with its carrier; no observed possession or physical-state change.",
    "Loose produce in left-side displays | Red, green, yellow, orange, and dark fruit resting in trays and boxes on stall tables | Successive displays remain filled as camera motion reveals additional turquoise, purple, and pale-green produce | Apparent screen movement follows camera travel; individual fruit identities in dense piles cannot be reliably resolved, and no specific unsupported transition is visible.",
    "Loose produce in right-side displays | Red and green fruit in foreground wooden boxes and a blue tub, with other produce farther back | Remains supported in the displays until camera movement takes it out of view | No visible pickup, spill, or identifiable spontaneous relocation.",
    "Hanging produce bunches | Red and green bunches suspended above the stalls | Remain suspended while visible | Camera travel and passing people change visibility; no observed detachment or state change.",
    "Produce trays, bins, and wooden display boxes | Open red, green, blue, purple, white, and wooden containers supporting produce on stall stands | Remain open and supported in their display positions while visible | Additional containers enter view through camera travel; no identifiable container moves independently or changes state.",
    "Cardboard stock boxes | Open and closed brown boxes stacked on stall counters behind the produce | Remain on the counters while visible | Intermittently occluded by pedestrians; no visible handling or unsupported transition.",
    "Display price cards | Small light-colored rectangular cards propped among produce | Remain propped in the displays while visible | Enter and leave view with camera movement; no observable relocation or state change.",
    "Fixed market parasols | Open red parasols above the aisle and stalls | Remain open on their poles while visible | Perspective changes as the camera travels; no opening, closing, or unsupported displacement."
